primary_action: Use the exact current upstream installation action only after identity/version review.
fallbacks: Use the upstream-documented manual installation path when the primary package path is unavailable.
HOLD instead of inventing a command when upstream documentation is ambiguous.
observable_verification: Confirm the installed identity/version from the installed tool itself.
Run one harmless representative capability check and retain its output.
prohibited_actions: Do not execute a similarly named package without upstream identity verification.
Do not bypass authentication or permission boundaries.
Do not log or paste secrets into receipts.
provenance_refs: canonical upstream repository or vendor documentation
